purpose: Milestone 9.7 Section 2: machine-readable reconstruction of the frozen M9.6 HydroCore-S architecture/recipe, verified against source code (src/hydroswarm/model/core.py, encoders.py, layers.py, adapters.py, candidate_plan_encoder.py) and the actual M9.6 training scripts/config (scripts/hydrocore_v5/run_m9_6_train_arm_a.py, run_m9_6_train_arm_b.py, run_m8_7_arm.py's ARM_DEFINITIONS/SHARED_MODEL_CONFIG), not prose documentation alone.

source_of_truth.variant_definition: MODEL_VARIANTS['small'] = ModelVariant(d_model=192, nhead=6, dim_feedforward=576, num_layers=4, latent_tokens=64, modality_layers=1)

graph_encoder_configuration.structure: Linear(4, hidden_dim) -> activation -> norm -> Linear(hidden_dim, d_model)

temporal_encoder_configuration.core: nn.TransformerEncoder(nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model, nhead, dim_feedforward, dropout, activation=silu, batch_first=True, norm_first=True), num_layers=modality_layers)
temporal_encoder_configuration.positional_encoding: learned sinusoidal frequency parameter (d_model//2), phase = elapsed_time * frequency
temporal_encoder_configuration.elapsed_time_normalization: window_relative (AGE_FIX_ONLY does not change this; AGE_FIX_ONLY changes unobserved_age_sentinel in the FEATURE BUILDER, not this encoder arg)
temporal_encoder_configuration.pooling: masked temporal mean over valid (finite & sensor-observed) timesteps
temporal_encoder_configuration.quality_encoder: identical TemporalEncoder subclass, separate instance, input_dim=quality_feature_dim

pooling.incident_pooling: mean (default; IncidentPooling='mean' -- unconditional global mean pool over valid nodes)
pooling.backbone_latent_pooling: bounded global_latents (latent_tokens=64) cross-attend to/from node states each backbone block (LatentHydraulicBlock: to_latent, latent_self, to_node MultiheadAttention)

residual_paths.backbone: hidden = hidden + node_update (post cross-attention), hidden = hidden + feed_forward(hidden); EdgeAwareGraphConv: hidden + dropout(update)
residual_paths.optional_residual_features: hidden = hidden + residual_projection(residual_features) when residual_features is supplied

normalization: rmsnorm (nn.RMSNorm) throughout; RoleHead/BottleneckAdapter internals use nn.LayerNorm explicitly

every_output_head.ood_head: RoleHead(d_model, 3) -- deterministic-severity-adjacent, NOT the governed ood_class target
every_output_head.auxiliary_heads: DISABLED (auxiliary_heads=False, not part of the frozen S recipe)

topology_dependent_behavior: Fully variable-topology: node_features/edge_index/edge_features/node_mask/edge_mask are all per-batch tensors with no fixed node-count assumption anywhere in the forward pass; EdgeAwareGraphConv aggregates via index_add_ over the supplied edge_index; global_latents (count=latent_tokens, fixed=64 regardless of topology) provide the only fixed-size internal state, cross-attending to a variable number of node positions via key_padding_mask=~node_mask.

classical_prior_interface.behavior: hidden = hidden + prior_projection(classical_prior.unsqueeze(-1)) when prior_mode in ('feature_only','feature_and_logit'); prior_logit_scale parameter exists but is unused in feature_only mode (present for checkpoint-shape compatibility across prior_mode values only)

AGE_FIX_ONLY_behavior.feature_builder_kwarg: unobserved_age_sentinel='fixed' (HydraulicFeatureBuilder.build, NOT a HydroCore constructor arg)
AGE_FIX_ONLY_behavior.model_constructor_kwarg: elapsed_time_normalization='window_relative' (unchanged from CURRENT_CONTROL; AGE_FIX_ONLY's fix is entirely in the feature builder, not the model)
AGE_FIX_ONLY_behavior.effect: never-observed-node measurement_age fallback uses a fixed sentinel (86,400s) independent of the incident's own timestamp origin, restoring timestamp-origin invariance (M8.7 finding).

candidate_conditioned_behavior.leakage_rule: restricted to pre-WNTR-verification information only, by construction (module docstring)

inference_interface.eval_mode: torch.no_grad(), model.eval() for all M9.x inference (M9.1 protocol Section 2 convention, inherited)

checkpoint_compatibility_semantics.verify_architecture_compatibility: checks architecture_version/use_adapters/prior_mode/incident_pooling/message_direction/event_control_heads/auxiliary_heads/consequence_prescreening_heads/strategist_mode/ood_category_head/scout_control_heads against checkpoint metadata before/after load_state_dict
checkpoint_compatibility_semantics.load_state_dict_with_v2_migration: narrow, explicit v2->v3 source_region_head migration path; not otherwise relevant to S (S was always trained under v3)

frozen_semantics_not_to_change_for_capac: prior_mode, incident_pooling, message_direction, strategist_mode, event_control_heads, scout_control_heads, consequence_prescreening_heads, ood_category_head (all SHARED_MODEL_CONFIG values)
output head identities and class counts
verification_method: Direct instantiation via HydroCore.from_variant('small', use_adapters=False, **AGE_FIX_ONLY_model_kwargs, **SHARED_MODEL_CONFIG) in this environment; parameter_report()/architecture_config() called on the live instance (not estimated) -- total=4,182,612, matching every M8.7/M9.0-line/M9.6 historical record verbatim.
